title: Clarification of Wastewater Samples
author: Victor Mabasa
materials: Wearing appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE), collect a 1 000 mL grab wastewater sample from each location using a sterile bottle. Transport the samples to the laboratory under cold chain conditions and store them at 4 °C. To minimise microbial degradation, proceed to the next step within 23 hours of sample collection.

steps.title: Prepare workspace and materials
steps.instruction: Set up a Class II biological safety cabinet, wear appropriate PPE, clean the work area with 1 % Virkon followed by 70 % ethanol, double‑line the waste container with biohazard bags, refill all filter tip racks, and label a 250 mL conical centrifuge bottle for each wastewater sample.

substeps.instruction: Work in a Class II biosafety cabinet wearing PPE
Clean workspace with 1 % Virkon then 70 % ethanol
Double‑line waste container with biohazard bags
Label a 250 mL conical centrifuge bottle for each sample

steps.title: Transfer samples to bottles
steps.instruction: Transfer each wastewater sample into its corresponding labeled 250 mL conical centrifuge bottle, taking care not to overfill and cause spillage during centrifugation.

steps.title: Centrifuge and decant supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the bottles at 4 700 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C, then carefully transfer the supernatant to a clean, marked 1 000 mL bottle without disturbing the settled solids; repeat this centrifugation and decanting cycle until the original sample is completely processed.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 700 × g for 10 min at 4 °C
Transfer supernatant to a clean, marked 1 000 mL bottle without disturbing solids

steps.title: Aliquot clarified supernatant
steps.instruction: Aliquot six 5 mL cryotubes with the clarified supernatant and store them at –80 °C for long‑term preservation; keep any remaining clarified wastewater at 4 °C for other downstream applications.

steps.title: Collect and store settled solids
steps.instruction: Using clean, plain wooden sticks, collect the settled solids, transfer them into labeled 2 mL cryotubes, briefly centrifuge to remove excess liquid, and store the tubes at –80 °C until needed for downstream applications.
